title: Page layout segmentation
description: Geometry only. Candidate layout regions detected from one rendered page image by deterministic code, with no text, no transcription and no educational interpretation. This is the frame a reader's source-page transcription is later bound to; it never carries what a region says.

image_sha256.description: Checksum of the rendered page these regions were measured from. Regions are only valid for that exact image.

diagnostics.description: Free-form detector counters kept for debugging. Never authority for anything.

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in rendered-page pixels, x1/y1 exclusive.

type.description: Structural role inferred from geometry and ink alone. 'unknown' is a legitimate answer and must not be guessed away.

reading_order.description: Zero-based position in the page's reading sequence: band by band, column by column, block by block.

parent.description: Region id of the containing panel when this region sits inside a tint panel or callout box.

column.description: Zero-based column index within the region's band; null when the region spans the full width.

line_count.description: Printed rows detected inside the region. A count of ink rows, not a transcription.

evidence.description: Why the detector chose this type: component counts, areas, rule counts. Diagnostic only.
